comparison.objective: Scribe a complete circle while keeping divider points seated; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record emphasizes continuous pivot seating, downward pressure and circular regrasping. Candidate emphasizes hex-key engagement, collar rotation, counterholding and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record measures seated angular coverage and forbids stray scratches. Candidate measures repeated stopping performance, stroke limits and lock retention; rebound, overload and drift thresholds remain unspecified.
comparison.reason: The common need for controlled rotation does not equate precision scribing with adjustable-damper commissioning.
